outcomes.PASS: Lowest preregistered sufficient tier is certified on the complete frozen pair observer; earn it only as the bounded candidate read for S3 and unlock G4:S3.
outcomes.REVIEW_REQUIRED: No preregistered tier is sufficient, or authority/evidence binding fails; lock S3.

promotion_rule: S2 does not globally promote a public G4 descriptor. It earns only the lowest bounded pair-observer candidate for mandatory S3 higher-order irreducibility testing.
question: After certified G4:S1 proves CAPS7 insufficient on the frozen equal-CAPS7 G3 term pair, what is the lowest preregistered relabel-invariant challenge-read tier that makes the complete registered G4:S1 pair-context operational observer single-valued?

quotient_test.rule: For each preregistered tier, replace exact target/context refs in every certified S1 row by that tier descriptor value; group by (target descriptor, context descriptor, operator, orientation). The tier is sufficient iff every grouped key has exactly one operational signature SHA-256.
